contents.text:
# Asset analysis — portfolio holdings review

You are analyzing a user's holdings. Follow this exact pattern. You do NOT have
the data yet — fetch it with the tools below, then compute everything locally.

## Step 1 — Fetch holdings (read-only)
Call `getMainAccountAsset` tool. It returns the user's main account holdings:
per-asset quantity + BTC valuation (and a total). Do NOT copy raw rows into the
final answer — you will aggregate them.

## Step 2 — Pick top assets, fetch their reports
From the holdings, rank assets by BTC valuation and take the top ones
(cap at top-5 to limit fan-out). For each, call `getTokenAiReport` with
`token=<asset symbol>` (default `product="spot"`). The tool returns the nearest
available AI report; if a token has no report it returns `available=false` —
note "report unavailable" for that asset and continue; never fabricate.

## Step 3 — Compute concentration LOCALLY (the server does not do this)
From the BTC valuations returned in Step 2, compute:
- per-asset BTC allocation %  = asset_btc_value / total_btc_value
- largest-asset concentration % = max allocation
- top-3 concentration %        = sum of the 3 largest allocations
- stablecoin ratio %           = sum of allocations for USDT/USDC/FDUSD/DAI/TUSD/BUSD

## Step 4 — Synthesize (use this template)
```text
Portfolio snapshot
- Total tracked assets: N
- Largest allocation: <ASSET> (<pct>%)
- Top-3 concentration: <pct>%
- Stablecoin ratio: <pct>%

Top holdings
- <ASSET>: <btc_value> BTC value, <pct>%
- ...

Report takeaways
- <ASSET>: <1-2 line takeaway from its token report>
- ...

Risk flags
- <e.g. "Top-3 concentration is high (>80%)">
- <e.g. "BTC overweight relative to the rest of the portfolio">
- <e.g. "Idle stablecoin ratio is high — could earn yield">
```

## Constraints
- READ-ONLY. Do not place/modify/cancel orders or move funds. If the user wants
  to act on a finding, hand off to the execution/CONFIRM flow — out of scope here.
- Compute all ratios yourself from the returned BTC valuations. Present
  aggregated, decision-useful views — never dump raw per-row payloads.
- If `getMainAccountAsset` errors or returns empty, say the holdings are unavailable and
  stop; do not invent numbers.
- Keep report takeaways to 1-2 lines each; the reports can be long.
